text:
rachel_fin: Invoice INV-2024-417 shows an unexpected "public egress" line for $2,750 on Oct billing. Starting renewal talks with LedgerBridge; tagging @dave_procure @sara_eng to triage.

dave_procure: Can you attach the invoice snippet? I'll ask LedgerBridge for a breakdown and any one-time credit. What's our renewal cutoff?

rachel_fin: Snippet: "INV-2024-417 Total $38,920 — Network egress (public): $2,750" Renewal auto-renews 2024-12-10.

billingbot: Invoice INV-2024-417 posted 2024-10-06. Due 2024-11-05.

sara_eng: We flipped on raw export to public bucket for the invoice-enrich job on Sep 13; that explains the egress. We can switch to VPC S3 endpoint to avoid public egress. Is a connector pilot part of the renewal?

alex_ledgerbridge: Hi folks, Alex from LedgerBridge. Sorry about the surprise charge. We can offer: (1) one-time migration credit for the $2,750, (2) a 90-day egress cap with a ramp (we propose $800 / $1,600 / $2,400), and (3) waive first month of dedicated connector fee for pilot. Will put in an updated SOW and SKU-level invoice.

dave_procure: Need the 90-day cap + ramp in writing and updated invoice with SKU breakdown and a migration credit line. Also confirm dedicated connector supports streaming with backpressure.

sara_eng: Connector must support streaming + backpressure. Also want configurable max outstanding bytes.

alex_ledgerbridge: Connector supports streaming/backpressure and configurable limits. We'll include a sample config and the ramp in the SOW. Draft SOW link: https://ledgerbridge.example.com/sow/RW-417 (internal).

maria_legal: Legal OK to review 12-month commitment if SOW includes SLA, egress responsibility clause, and a data portability section. I'll prepare redlines after SOW.

rachel_fin: Finance tentatively approves payment once the migration credit is applied to INV-2024-417 and SOW terms look good. Thanks — please send SOW asap. :thumbsup:
